description: Typed Jev decision support: workflow recommendation, clarification triage, and a prompt-injection integrity gate — with conservative abstention whenever signals disagree.

Batched Jev readiness gates for BMAD phase transitions (Analysis to Planning to Solutioning to Implementation): three noul gates plus an ordered readiness score; any failure holds the transition with a typed blocker.
Jev-as-judge story review: three hard gates (correctness, tests, no-mocks) plus four scored dimensions and a typed failure taxonomy; escalates to a human after two failed reworks.
